name: Caribbean Development Bank
mandate: Advance sustainable economic and social development in Caribbean borrowing member countries.
activities: Provides development financing and technical assistance, with dedicated programmes for resilient infrastructure and sustainable energy.
plainLanguage: CDB helps Caribbean governments and eligible institutions pay for development priorities such as resilient infrastructure and cleaner energy. Its borrowing members can access the bank’s financing.

access.details: Borrowing member countries can work with CDB on development financing. Consult individual programmes for eligibility.

name: Inter-American Development Bank
mandate: Support economic and social development in Latin America and the Caribbean.
activities: Finances public sector operations and provides technical assistance.
plainLanguage: IDB lends to and advises public institutions in the region. IDB Invest and IDB Lab have distinct roles within the same group.

name: Inter-American Investment Corporation
mandate: Support sustainable development through the private sector in Latin America and the Caribbean.
activities: Provides loans, equity and guarantees to private businesses and financial institutions.
plainLanguage: IDB Invest finances companies and intermediaries whose investments can contribute to development.

access.details: Consult IDB Invest for project structuring and eligibility.

name: World Bank (IBRD and IDA)
mandate: Support poverty reduction and sustainable development through IBRD and IDA.
activities: Provides financing and policy advice, including concessional credits and grants through IDA.
plainLanguage: The World Bank works with governments. Its two institutions serve different borrower groups and offer financing on different terms.

name: World Bank Group
mandate: Work toward poverty reduction and shared prosperity through five development institutions.
activities: Brings together public sector, private sector, guarantee and dispute-settlement institutions.
plainLanguage: The group includes the World Bank’s public sector lenders and IFC, which focuses on private enterprise.

name: International Finance Corporation
mandate: Promote private sector development in emerging markets.
activities: Invests in private sector operations and provides advice, including in Latin America and the Caribbean.
plainLanguage: IFC backs businesses and financial institutions to advance development goals.

name: European Investment Bank
mandate: Provide long-term investment financing in support of European Union policy goals.
activities: Supports climate and infrastructure investments in the Caribbean, including through regional bank partners.
plainLanguage: The EU’s member-owned bank lends for priorities such as resilient water and waste systems.

name: Development Bank of Jamaica Limited
mandate: Promote Jamaican economic and social development.
activities: Provides financing through approved financial institutions and offers selected direct lending.
plainLanguage: DBJ works with local lenders to help Jamaican businesses obtain development finance.

access.details: Review the list of approved financial institutions for intermediary loans.

name: Caribbean Community Climate Change Centre
mandate: Coordinate the region’s climate response and support climate resilience.
activities: Provides climate information, project development support and a regional accredited route to GCF.
plainLanguage: The Centre helps Caribbean countries develop responses to climate risks and prepare climate finance proposals.

name: Caribbean Climate-Smart Accelerator Inc.
mandate: Accelerate regional climate resilience and low-carbon development.
activities: Helps climate initiatives prepare for funding and connect with partners.
plainLanguage: The Accelerator helps connect Caribbean climate projects with expertise and potential finance.

name: CCRIF SPC
mandate: Provide rapid disaster liquidity to participating governments through parametric insurance.
activities: Pools risk and offers policies triggered by modeled hazard and loss measures.
plainLanguage: Participating governments can buy policies that pay when agreed disaster triggers are met.

name: Caribbean Community
mandate: Advance regional integration, cooperation and development.
activities: Coordinates common priorities among Caribbean member states and associate members.
plainLanguage: CARICOM gives Caribbean governments a way to pursue shared policy and economic goals.

name: Caribbean Export Development Agency
mandate: Support regional trade, investment and private sector development.
activities: Implements programmes and provides enterprise support across CARIFORUM.
plainLanguage: The agency helps Caribbean businesses build capacity, reach markets and participate in specific support programmes.

name: European Union
mandate: Cooperate with Caribbean partners on sustainable development and economic priorities.
activities: Provides development cooperation and investment support through instruments including LACIF.
plainLanguage: The EU helps fund regional programmes and combines grants with development-bank financing in some facilities.

name: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
mandate: Deliver UK foreign and development policy, including Caribbean partnerships.
activities: Supports development programmes including resilient Caribbean infrastructure.
plainLanguage: The UK department funds development programmes that are delivered with regional partners.

name: Republic Financial Holdings Limited
mandate: Oversee the Republic group of financial services businesses.
activities: Owns commercial banks and other financial subsidiaries.
plainLanguage: The holding company owns banks that deliver services in individual markets.

name: Republic Bank (Barbados) Limited
mandate: Provide banking services in Barbados.
activities: Offers personal and commercial banking products.
plainLanguage: Businesses and individuals can work with the local bank on accounts and credit products.

access.details: Consult Republic Bank Barbados for product eligibility and applications.

name: CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited
mandate: Provide commercial and retail banking services in regional markets.
activities: Operates banks and financial services subsidiaries across the Caribbean.
plainLanguage: The bank provides everyday banking and business finance through its local operations.

name: Royal Bank of Canada
mandate: Provide banking services through regional operations.
activities: Offers personal and business banking products in selected Caribbean markets.
plainLanguage: RBC serves customers through local Caribbean banking operations. Available products vary by market.

access.details: Choose the relevant market on the regional site and review its local products.

name: Sagicor Financial Company Ltd.
mandate: Provide insurance and related financial services in the Caribbean and North America.
activities: Operates insurance and financial services businesses in several markets.
plainLanguage: The group sells insurance and other financial products through its operating companies.

name: Sagicor Life Inc
mandate: Provide insurance and financial services to Caribbean customers.
activities: Offers insurance, mortgages, asset management and pension services.
plainLanguage: Customers can use the company for insurance and selected savings, investment and lending products.

name: Guardian Holdings Limited
mandate: Oversee regional insurance and financial services businesses.
activities: Operates through regional life and general insurance subsidiaries.
plainLanguage: The group serves insurance customers through local operating companies.

name: National Insurance and Social Security Service
mandate: Administer social insurance for eligible contributors and beneficiaries in Barbados.
activities: Collects contributions, administers benefits and oversees investment of the National Insurance Fund.
plainLanguage: Workers and employers contribute to social insurance. The service uses contributions and invested reserves to support benefit payments.

name: National Insurance Board of Trinidad and Tobago
mandate: Administer national insurance benefits in Trinidad and Tobago.
activities: Collects contributions and invests reserves to support benefit payments.
plainLanguage: The board invests part of the national insurance scheme’s resources to help finance benefits.

name: Sygnus Capital Limited
mandate: Connect businesses and investors with alternative capital.
activities: Manages investment vehicles and assists clients with debt and equity financing.
plainLanguage: Sygnus Capital structures and manages investments through distinct vehicles for strategies such as private credit.

name: JN Fund Managers Limited
mandate: Provide investment and securities services.
activities: Manages investments, brokers securities and provides investment banking services.
plainLanguage: The manager runs investment products and helps clients buy or sell securities.

name: The Barbados Agency for Micro Enterprise Development Ltd.
mandate: Provide development finance for Barbados micro, small and medium enterprises.
activities: Offers lending and business development support.
plainLanguage: Eligible Barbados entrepreneurs can submit an application for a business loan and access guidance.

access.details: Check the loan categories and application documents on the official site.

name: Government of Barbados
mandate: Manage public policy and investment in Barbados.
activities: Oversees public finance and investments and participates in regional disaster insurance.
plainLanguage: The government manages Barbados’s public finances and can transfer some disaster risks through regional insurance.

name: Development Finance Institute Canada (DFIC) Inc.
mandate: Advance sustainable private sector development in emerging markets and developing economies.
activities: Provides development finance, investment and blended finance, including direct lending for renewable infrastructure.
plainLanguage: Canada’s development finance institution finances businesses and infrastructure that can advance development goals.

name: InterEnergy Group Limited
mandate: Develop and operate power infrastructure in Latin America and the Caribbean.
activities: Invests in generation and electricity infrastructure, including renewable energy assets.
plainLanguage: The group invests in and operates power businesses. Its subsidiaries develop specific projects and can borrow in their own name.

name: Energia Turistica Enertur S.A.
mandate: Develop power generation and storage infrastructure in the Dominican Republic.
activities: Acts as the project company for the La Romana solar and battery storage development.
plainLanguage: This company is the borrowing and development vehicle for a solar and battery storage investment.

name: Caribbean Biodiversity Fund
mandate: Provide long-term financing for Caribbean conservation and sustainable development.
activities: Manages an endowment and provides conservation and ecosystem adaptation grants through distinct mechanisms.
plainLanguage: This regional nonprofit runs several ways to fund nature protection and climate adaptation.

name: The Nature Conservancy
mandate: Support conservation through financing and partnerships.
activities: Provides conservation support and credit enhancement in the Barbados debt-for-nature conversion.
plainLanguage: The nonprofit agreed to cover a defined share of credit risk so Barbados could obtain more favourable loan terms.

name: Government of Jamaica
mandate: Manage Jamaica’s public finances, including disaster risk financing.
activities: Pays premiums for hurricane cover through a risk transfer agreement with the World Bank.
plainLanguage: Jamaica can receive funds after a qualifying storm if the contract’s payout conditions are met.

name: Enterprise Growth Fund Limited
mandate: Provide and administer financing for Barbadian enterprises.
activities: Manages domestic lending and business-support funds, including the separate Energy Smart Fund II pool.
plainLanguage: EGFL administers the resources used to finance energy improvements by Barbados businesses.

name: Global Affairs Canada
mandate: Deliver Canadian international development cooperation.
activities: Funds the CDB-administered SuRGE programme through Canadian financing agreements.
plainLanguage: Canada supplies public finance for projects and technical assistance that support the Caribbean energy transition.

name: FMO (Dutch Entrepreneurial Development Bank)
mandate: Support private sector development through investment and financing.
activities: Participated in the Enertur solar and battery storage financing led by IDB Invest.
plainLanguage: The Dutch development bank provided a loan alongside other lenders for renewable power in the Dominican Republic.

name: United States Department of the Treasury
mandate: Named donor to the second CCRIF multi-donor trust fund.
activities: US Treasury contributes to the second donor trust fund.
plainLanguage: Named donor to the second CCRIF multi-donor trust fund.

name: Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (Germany)
mandate: Named bilateral funding source for CCRIF through KfW.
activities: BMZ resources are channelled through KfW for this trust fund.
plainLanguage: Named bilateral funding source for CCRIF through KfW.

name: KfW Development Bank
mandate: Documented German funding channel for the CBF adaptation facility.
activities: BMZ resources are channelled through KfW for this trust fund. KfW is the named channel for German resources. KfW implements the earmarked IKI support.
plainLanguage: Documented German funding channel for the CBF adaptation facility.

name: Export Development Canada
type: Public export credit and financing institution
mandate: Documented debt and equity funding relationship to FinDev Canada. Transaction-specific Enertur attribution is unresolved.
activities: EDC supplies equity to its FinDev subsidiary. EDC supplies FinDev debt funding.
plainLanguage: Documented debt and equity funding relationship to FinDev Canada. Transaction-specific Enertur attribution is unresolved.

name: Standard Chartered Bank
mandate: Identified sole lender for The Bahamas conservation-linked debt conversion.
activities: The bank is the sole lender in the new commercial loan.
plainLanguage: Identified sole lender for The Bahamas conservation-linked debt conversion.

name: Government of The Bahamas
mandate: Sovereign borrower implementing conservation-linked refinancing and commitments.
activities: The bank is the sole lender in the new commercial loan. Conservation funding is channelled to the national conservation trust fund.
plainLanguage: Sovereign borrower implementing conservation-linked refinancing and commitments.

name: The Bahamas Protected Areas Fund
mandate: Conservation trust fund designated to manage resulting conservation finance. Governance and ownership need constituting-document review.
activities: Conservation funding is channelled to the national conservation trust fund. BPAF manages the resulting conservation funding.
plainLanguage: Conservation trust fund designated to manage resulting conservation finance. Governance and ownership need constituting-document review.

name: Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (Germany)
mandate: Named IKI funding source for Caribbean ecosystem-based adaptation. Source-era ministry names are retained as dated aliases.
activities: German environment funding supports the IKI programme leg. German environment-ministry resources support the CBF adaptation facility through IKI and KfW. This link identifies the public source and implementing channel.
plainLanguage: Named IKI funding source for Caribbean ecosystem-based adaptation. Source-era ministry names are retained as dated aliases.

name: Planning Institute of Jamaica
mandate: National implementing entity receiving the Adaptation Fund's documented Jamaican grant.
activities: PIOJ receives the direct-access grant. PIOJ is the national implementing entity. The funded programme targets Jamaican agricultural and coastal communities.
plainLanguage: National implementing entity receiving the Adaptation Fund's documented Jamaican grant.

name: Barbados Water Authority
mandate: Named utility beneficiary in Barbados' GCF-funded water resilience mechanism.
activities: The utility is an identified programme beneficiary.
plainLanguage: Named utility beneficiary in Barbados' GCF-funded water resilience mechanism.

name: United Nations Environment Programme
mandate: Documented co-implementing agency for the CReW+ regional environmental financing programme.
activities: UNEP is a co-implementing agency.
plainLanguage: Documented co-implementing agency for the CReW+ regional environmental financing programme.

name: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
mandate: Named executing agency for CReW+, with earlier CRAF technical assistance also documented.
activities: GIZ is a named executing agency.
plainLanguage: Named executing agency for CReW+, with earlier CRAF technical assistance also documented.

name: U.S. International Development Finance Corporation
mandate: Named political risk insurer in the Belize conservation debt conversion.
activities: DFC provides political risk insurance for principal and interest.
plainLanguage: Named political risk insurer in the Belize conservation debt conversion.

name: Government of Belize
mandate: Sovereign borrower and conservation-funding obligor in the documented 2021 debt conversion.
activities: The special-purpose lender extended Belize's Blue Loan.
plainLanguage: Sovereign borrower and conservation-funding obligor in the documented 2021 debt conversion.

name: Belize Blue Investment Company, LLC
mandate: Special-purpose lender in the Belize blue-loan arrangement.
activities: Credit Suisse funded the special-purpose lender through the repackaging structure. The special-purpose lender extended Belize's Blue Loan. TNC supplied reserve-related equity support to its subsidiary structure.
plainLanguage: Special-purpose lender in the Belize blue-loan arrangement.
